title: “Between 2015 and 2020, ICE deported at least 70 people who were...
content: “Between 2015 and 2020, ICE deported at least 70 people who were U.S. citizens” and detained or arrested many more. “ICE has not implemented a reliable system to track and correct its mistakes.” (Or: the purpose of a system is what it does.)
author: Jason Kottke
